sentences: I measure one teaspoon of loose black tea leaves and place them into the ceramic teapot.
I check the water temperature with a thermometer and wait until it reaches exactly two hundred degrees Fahrenheit.
I pour the hot water over the tea bag in my mug and watch the color spread.
I set a timer for three minutes to steep the green tea before removing the leaves.
I lift the tea bag from the cup by its string and let the excess liquid drip back.
I stir the tea with a small metal spoon to dissolve the sugar I added.
I pour a splash of milk into the black tea and observe the color change.
I add one teaspoon of honey to the chamomile tea and stir it clockwise.
I squeeze a wedge of lemon into the iced tea and drop the rind in.
I take a small sip of the tea to check if it is too strong.
I pour the tea from the teapot into a white cup until it is three-quarters full.
I rinse the teapot with hot water after each use to remove the old leaves.
I wash the teacup by hand with dish soap and place it on the drying rack.
I store the loose tea leaves in an airtight tin to keep them dry.
I choose a box of English breakfast tea from the shelf at the grocery store.
I read the brewing instructions on the back of the tea box before opening it.
I fill the kettle with fresh water and place it on the stove to boil.
I wait for the tea to cool for five minutes before I drink it from the cup.
I drink a cup of tea every morning at seven o'clock before I start my day.
I make iced tea by brewing strong tea and pouring it over ice cubes in a glass.
